name: Proof Presentation Normalization
purpose: Normalize proof readability, notation usage, dependency visibility, and relation-preservation requirements.

normalization_requirements.requirement: Use standardized symbols: Π_A, NavT, δ, R, CSI, -(i), (E≠0) ⇔R δ(E>0).
Explicitly state meaning resides in the relation ⇔R, not sides.
Explicitly link every step to FSUB substrate objects.
Every proof section must declare what is abstracted or lost.
Explicitly list local-domain assumptions at the start of each package.
Maintain active counterexample links and boundary conditions.
Explicitly qualify all quantifiers as local/restricted.

governance_rules.rule: Every proof package must pass the presentation normalization audit before external-style review.
